name: Redstone Link Frequency
description: The two-item code that pairs Redstone Links.

pages.title: Redstone Link Frequency
pages.text:
A Redstone Link's **frequency** is set by two items in its slots. A powered transmitter powers every receiver with the same pair, anywhere.\
\
Other blocks bind to these frequencies too: Aeroworks control consoles and coaster Restrictor seats.
